wc:minerva-number-input.summary: Numeric field with keyboard stepping, stepper, min / max and precision.
wc:minerva-number-input.description: Numeric text field (`<NumberInput>` of React, `role="spinbutton"`) with keyboard stepping, an optional stepper, min / max clamping and fixed precision. The draft may hold intermediate text ("-", "1.") while typing; it is committed on blur / Enter. Keyboard: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step, PageUp / PageDown step by 10 steps, Home / End jump to min / max (only when bounded). Mouse wheel never changes the value. Form-associated: submits the committed value (formatted with the precision; `""` when empty) under `name`. Validity: `required` + empty -> `valueMissing`; a non-numeric draft -> `badInput`; a draft (or value) below `min` / above `max` -> `rangeUnderflow` / `rangeOverflow` (localized messages). Supports `form.reset()` (restores the `value` attribute), `<fieldset disabled>` and state restoration. Name it with `<label for>`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

stepper-precision.title: Stepper and precision
stepper-precision.description: showStepper adds buttons; precision is inferred from step unless set; allowEmpty={false} falls back to min.

form-control.title: With FormField
form-control.description: The field provides the label, state and description; readOnly blocks typing and stepping.

NumberInputProps.value: Current value (controlled); `null` is an empty field. Omit for an uncontrolled field
NumberInputProps.defaultValue: Initial value of an uncontrolled field
NumberInputProps.onChange: Called with the committed value (on blur / Enter, stepping and stepper clicks), never while typing; `null` when the field is cleared
NumberInputProps.min: Smallest allowed value; committed values are clamped to it
NumberInputProps.max: Largest allowed value; committed values are clamped to it
NumberInputProps.step: Amount added / removed by ArrowUp / ArrowDown and the stepper
NumberInputProps.precision: Decimal places of the value; inferred from step when omitted (step 0.01 -> 2)
NumberInputProps.invalid: Error state (also set by an invalid FormControl or an out-of-range draft)
NumberInputProps.disabled: Disables the field (also set by FormControl)
NumberInputProps.readOnly: Focusable and copyable, but typing and stepping do not change the value (also set by FormControl)
NumberInputProps.showStepper: Shows increment / decrement buttons; the arrow keys always work
NumberInputProps.allowEmpty: Clearing the field commits `null`; otherwise it falls back to min (or 0)
NumberInputProps.incrementLabel: Accessible label of the increment button
NumberInputProps.decrementLabel: Accessible label of the decrement button
NumberInputProps.notANumberMessage: Hint shown (as the wrapper title) while the draft is not a number
NumberInputProps.belowMinMessage: Hint shown while the draft is below min
NumberInputProps.aboveMaxMessage: Hint shown while the draft is above max

cssVars.--number-input-stepper-width: Width of the increment / decrement column

events.change: A value was committed (blur, Enter or stepping).

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.stepUp: Adds step to the value (clamped to max); does not emit events.
methods.stepDown: Subtracts step from the value (clamped to min); does not emit events.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
